reversing_premises: The selected-result denominator were the 72 retained stations while the claim text asserted the complete network.
Evidence showed the 24 omitted stations had known nonzero occurrences that were excluded while the report still asserted an exact (non-lower-bound) complete-network rate.
The scope covered numerator censoring of unobserved units as such, rather than substitution of a retained subset for the complete claimed domain.
falsification_attempt.strongest_innocent_explanation: N/A in guilty direction; the strongest opposing (issue-asserting) reading is that the occurrence information itself comes only from the 72 retained stations (omitted rows are NA), so the computation is 'really' subset-based despite the 96 denominator. This fails to reverse because the computation's domain matches the claim's domain (all 96 scheduled stations in the denominator, per report lines 14-15 and analysis.py line 23), the omitted units are retained rather than dropped, and the report explicitly bounds the claim as a lower bound (line 18), so the visible files show the in-scope substitution is absent.
